rules.title: Irrigate today.
rules.message: Suggested amount depends on farm size. Best time: Early morning / Evening.
rules.why: Your crop is in a high-water-demand stage and rainfall is insufficient.

rules.title: Check soil moisture tomorrow morning.
rules.message: Water if the soil feels dry.
rules.why: No irrigation has been recorded for a few days and weather is dry.

fallback.title: Check soil moisture today.
fallback.message: Use field moisture to decide whether irrigation is needed.
